title: A/P Summary: the Location menu lists the locations, ticked ones first
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The report's Location list has 8 locations or fewer on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Location chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Untick {Location-A}.
  3. Close the menu and open it again.
  4. Look for a search box in the menu.
  5. Click "Clear selection".
  6. Click "Select all".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a "Select all" row, a count of the ticked locations ("2 selected"), {Location-A} and {Location-B}, both ticked, and "Clear selection".
  • Step 2: the count reads "1 selected".
  • Step 3: the ticked location, {Location-B}, is listed first, then {Location-A}.
  • Step 4: there is no search box (8 locations or fewer).
  • Step 5: no location is ticked; the chip reads "Location: No locations".
  • Step 6: every location is ticked again; the chip reads "Location: All locations".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R2: “The Location chip and its open menu are the native ones, exactly as on Sales By Customer, Inventory Value and Work In Progress: label "Location" with the location pin icon; the menu shows a "Select all" row, a "{N} selected" count, the locations with the ticked ones first, a search box with the placeholder "Search locations" once there are more than 8 locations, and "Clear selection".”
  • S5-R5: “The filter opens with every location in the list ticked (All locations), so an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide rows and totals. "Select all" ticks every location again.”
  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”
